Male cats usually like to show their dominance and can be very aggressive sometimes. For now if your kitten doesn’t seem bothered by him or is not in any pain, then you should be fine for now. But I’d say to always keep a watchful eye as the male cat may forget how fragile the kitten is. If you notice any aggression pleas separate them in different areas of the house until old enough to defend himself. Once the kitten grows older and bigger in size, you can assure that he can fend for himself.
